stories.title: Connah’s Quay power plant steps up as wind output drops and grid operator asks for more generation
stories.summary: Connah’s Quay power station is running three of its four gas turbines at close to full output this morning, as Britain’s electricity system operator asks for extra generation. stories.summary: Ten roads in Flintshire are closed this week for roadworks, according to Flintshire County Council’s roadworks list and published roadworks notices. stories.title: Deeside Taekwondo Academy raises £510 for breast cancer charity
stories.summary: A wear it pink evening at Deeside Taekwondo Academy has raised £510 for the breast cancer awareness charity CoppaFeel! The charity was chosen by Deeside Taekwondo student Ellen Williams, and teaches young people to get to know their bodies, spot changes and know when to seek medical advice. stories.title: Neighbours and EastEnders stars are coming to Mold: Theatr Clwyd reveals its 2027 shows
stories.summary: Neighbours actor Stefan Dennis and EastEnders actor Charlie Brooks are among the names heading to Theatr Clwyd in Mold in 2027. The theatre has announced its touring programme for January to July, with drama, comedy, family shows and gigs. Dennis stars in The King’s Speech, adapted from the Oscar-winning film, from 2 to 6 February.
